instruction: Open Terminal and run `node "$HOME/Desktop/sherpa-onnx-tts.cjs"` to synthesize the text "The backup job completed successfully at 7:45 PM." as speech, saving the resulting WAV file to "$HOME/Desktop/sherpa_tts_1_4.wav".
reference_command: SHERPA_ONNX_RUNTIME_DIR="$HOME/.openclaw/tools/sherpa-onnx-tts/runtime" SHERPA_ONNX_MODEL_DIR="$HOME/.openclaw/tools/sherpa-onnx-tts/models/vits-piper-en_US-lessac-high" node "$HOME/Desktop/sherpa-onnx-tts.cjs" -o "$HOME/Desktop/sherpa_tts_1_4.wav" "The backup job completed successfully at 7:45 PM."
